# Reporter Assay Pipeline
> Command-line toolkit for processing paired-end reporter-assay sequencing data into element-level activity calls, diagnostic QC plots, and ExogeneousSequences export artifacts.

This site is the released user-observable contract for 0.1.0b3. Software: [haiyuan-yu-lab/reporter-assay-pipeline](https://github.com/haiyuan-yu-lab/reporter-assay-pipeline).

## Docs
- [Home](https://haiyuan-yu-lab.github.io/reporter-assay-pipeline-doc/): Reading paths (Learn, Run, Diagnose, Reference) and release contract note
- [Quickstart](https://haiyuan-yu-lab.github.io/reporter-assay-pipeline-doc/quickstart/): Install 0.1.0b3, prerequisites, and first-run inputs
- [Tasks](https://haiyuan-yu-lab.github.io/reporter-assay-pipeline-doc/tasks/): Task index for choosing a docs path by job
- [Workflow](https://haiyuan-yu-lab.github.io/reporter-assay-pipeline-doc/workflow/): Stages, artifact handoffs, completion, and resumption
- [CLI overview](https://haiyuan-yu-lab.github.io/reporter-assay-pipeline-doc/cli/): `yulab_reporter_pipe`, `yulab_reporter_qc`, and `yulab_reporter_export`
- [Pipeline CLI](https://haiyuan-yu-lab.github.io/reporter-assay-pipeline-doc/cli/pipe/): Steps, grouped orchestration, and flags
- [QC CLI](https://haiyuan-yu-lab.github.io/reporter-assay-pipeline-doc/cli/qc/): Read-only analytical plots over existing artifacts
- [Export CLI](https://haiyuan-yu-lab.github.io/reporter-assay-pipeline-doc/cli/export/): ExogeneousSequences FASTA and `.npy` export
- [Artifact formats](https://haiyuan-yu-lab.github.io/reporter-assay-pipeline-doc/formats/): Encodings, headers, columns, and summary schemas
- [FAQ](https://haiyuan-yu-lab.github.io/reporter-assay-pipeline-doc/faq/): Symptoms, likely stage, and recovery
- [Known limitations](https://haiyuan-yu-lab.github.io/reporter-assay-pipeline-doc/known-limitations/): Documented 0.1.0b3 defects and discrepancies
- [Glossary](https://haiyuan-yu-lab.github.io/reporter-assay-pipeline-doc/glossary/): EID, PID, eBC, pBC, CW, CCW, PreTran, PostTran, UMI, Element
